problems.quote: C–X stretching vibrations appear in the region 500–800 cm⁻¹
problems.problem: C–F stretching vibrations occur at higher wavenumbers (1000–1400 cm⁻¹), not in the 500–800 cm⁻¹ region. The statement incorrectly generalizes for all halogens.
problems.correction: C–Cl, C–Br, and C–I stretching vibrations appear in the region 500–800 cm⁻¹
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly generalizes for all halogens; C-F stretches at 1000-1400 cm⁻¹. Correction accurately specifies Cl, Br, I range.

problems.quote: All covalent bonds are classified as or bonds.
problems.problem: Missing sigma and pi; covalent bonds are classified as sigma (σ) and pi (π) bonds.
problems.correction: All covalent bonds are classified as sigma (σ) and pi (π) bonds.
problems.verifierReason: Original missing sigma/pi; correction accurately states classification.

problems.quote: Single bonds (C—C) consist of one bond.
problems.problem: Missing 'sigma'; single bonds consist of one sigma bond.
problems.correction: Single bonds (C—C) consist of one sigma bond.
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted sigma; correction correctly identifies single bond as sigma.

problems.quote: Double bonds (C=C) consist of one + one bond.
problems.problem: Missing 'sigma' and 'pi'; double bonds consist of one sigma and one pi bond.
problems.correction: Double bonds (C=C) consist of one sigma + one pi bond.
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted sigma/pi; correction correctly describes double bond composition.

problems.quote: Triple bonds (C≡C) consist of one + two bonds (the second bond is perpendicular to the first).
problems.problem: Missing 'sigma' and 'pi'; triple bonds consist of one sigma and two pi bonds.
problems.correction: Triple bonds (C≡C) consist of one sigma + two pi bonds (the second pi bond is perpendicular to the first).
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted sigma/pi; correction correctly describes triple bond with perpendicular pi bonds.

problems.quote: The electrons are more exposed and more polarizable than electrons
problems.problem: Missing 'pi' and 'sigma'; pi electrons are more exposed than sigma electrons.
problems.correction: The pi electrons are more exposed and more polarizable than sigma electrons
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted pi/sigma; correction correctly states pi electrons more exposed/polarizable.

problems.quote: Dipole moment: —I groups create a dipole with the positive end on the group.
problems.problem: -I groups withdraw electrons, making the group partially negative; the dipole has the negative end on the group.
problems.correction: Dipole moment: —I groups create a dipole with the negative end on the group.
problems.verifierReason: Original misstates dipole direction; correction correctly places negative end on -I group.

problems.problem: Misspelling of the enzyme name; correct term is penicillinase.
problems.verifierReason: Original 'penicillianase' is a misspelling; 'penicillinase' is the correct term for this β-lactamase.

problems.quote: SDS — sodium dodecylbenzenesulphonate; sodium lauryl sulphate
problems.problem: SDS stands for sodium dodecyl sulfate (sodium lauryl sulfate), not sodium dodecylbenzenesulphonate.
problems.correction: SDS — sodium dodecyl sulfate (sodium lauryl sulfate)
problems.verifierReason: SDS is sodium dodecyl sulfate (lauryl sulfate), not dodecylbenzenesulfonate; correction is accurate.
